newsitem.title: GERMANY: RESULTS OF BUNDESBANK POLL, JANUARY 21.
newsitem.headline: RESULTS OF BUNDESBANK POLL, JANUARY 21.

text.p: Following are the results
of a poll of 10 economists on the expected outcome of this
week's Bundesbank council meeting. The poll was conducted on
Tuesday.
1. Will the Bundesbank cut its leading interest rates this
week?
Yes 1
No 9
2. Will there be a further cut in the discount and lombard
rates later this year?
Yes 4
No 6
3. Will there be another fixed tender at 3.00 this Thursday?
Yes 10
No 0
Detailed results of the poll as follows:
Economist 1. 2. 3.
Gertrud Traud, Bank Julius Baer No. No. Yes.
Ros Lifton, HSBC Markets No. Yes. Yes.
Michael Schubert, Commerzbank No. No. Yes.
Gerard Lyons, DKB No. Yes. Yes.
Wilfried Bock, Norddt. Landesbank No. No. Yes.
